sources.entry: Tight Studio - Screen recorder with smart zoom, captions, and AI voiceovers.

summary.name: Tight Studio
summary.one_liner: Tight Studio is a free Mac screen recorder and editor for making product demos and user tutorials, with auto zoom, smooth cursors, captions, and AI voiceovers.
summary.what_it_does: Tight Studio records the screen and edits the result in one app, so recordings do not need to be exported to another editor. It adds smooth zoom and cursor animations automatically, with a choice of cursor icons. Captions are generated automatically and can be edited like text, and the AI voiceover can be re-recorded by editing the script. It also offers multi-clip recording and editing, layouts, backgrounds, on-video annotations, background music, and shareable links.
notable: Automatic smooth zoom and cursor animation, so little manual editing is needed
Captions and voiceover editable like text, with script-based re-recording
Free tier with no watermark; paid Plus tier adds unlimited multi-clip recording and links
Listed in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under Screen Recording
caveats: Free plan limits: 5 free clip additions, up to 5 shareable links with 7-day expiration, and 100 trial AI credits
Unlimited multi-clip recording, unlimited non-expiring links, AI voiceover and AI media generation, and team workspace are listed under paid Plus features
Pricing tiers beyond the free plan are not stated with amounts on the page
